title: Broken Box Lid
central_conflict: the community donation box could not close before a sudden storm
decisive_choice: one hinge had loosened and could be tightened with a spare pin
resolution: repaired the hinge and carried the dry donations to the community hall
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the community donation box could not close before a sudden storm before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they tied it with string, but the warped lid lifted in the wind; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized one hinge had loosened and could be tightened with a spare pin; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they repaired the hinge and carried the dry donations to the community hall, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Snow-Covered Lantern
central_conflict: the safety lantern disappeared beneath a fresh blanket of snow
decisive_choice: a warm patch beneath a nearby stone showed where its flame had melted snow
resolution: dug out the lantern safely and marked the route with bright ribbons
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the safety lantern disappeared beneath a fresh blanket of snow before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they swept the path, but the next gust hid every familiar landmark; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a warm patch beneath a nearby stone showed where its flame had melted snow; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they dug out the lantern safely and marked the route with bright ribbons, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Hidden Book Chapter
central_conflict: the old library book ended before its final chapter
decisive_choice: a penciled page number on a bookmark pointed to the repair desk
resolution: found the loose chapter and bound it into the book before the reading
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the old library book ended before its final chapter before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they checked the shelves, but the missing pages had no matching cover; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a penciled page number on a bookmark pointed to the repair desk; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they found the loose chapter and bound it into the book before the reading, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
